name: Marathwada Rain-Shadow Plateau
region: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar & Beed, Maharashtra · Deccan Trap Plateau
summary: Drought-prone semi-arid plateau experiencing erratic rainfall and soil erosion, pioneering community-led watershed restoration and stone terracing.

hotspots.title: Village Community Well & Recharge Shaft
hotspots.description: Traditional stone dug-well tapping shallow fractured basalt aquifers for village drinking water.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Prolonged 45-day rainless spells cause shallow open wells to dry up, leaving domestic water taps empty.
hotspots.impactProtect: Rooftop runoff and sub-surface recharge shafts replenish the basalt aquifer, keeping the village well functional year-round.

hotspots.title: Contour Bunds & Stone Terracing Slopes
hotspots.description: Engineered slope terracing with continuous contour trenches (CCT) designed to catch and soak monsoon downpours.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Intense erratic cloudbursts wash away topsoil on unprotected slopes, stripping fertile silt and silting farm ponds.
hotspots.impactProtect: Continuous contour trenches and stone bunding slow monsoon runoff, retaining rich black cotton soil on terraces.

hotspots.title: Community Grazing Common & Fodder Bank
hotspots.description: Shared village commons managed for livestock grazing, drought-tolerant legumes, and silvopasture.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Severe soil moisture deficit stunts seasonal grasses, forcing water tankers and emergency fodder procurement.
hotspots.impactProtect: Agroforestry tree belts, vetiver hedges, and multi-species silage banks secure local livestock fodder through dry spells.

stats.label: Water Tanker Demand
stats.context: Habitations requiring emergency governmental water tanker supply during pre-monsoon dry months.

stats.label: Soil Organic Carbon
stats.context: Topsoil biological carbon content governing water infiltration and moisture retention in black basalt soils.

stats.label: Longest Monsoon Dry Spell
stats.context: Consecutive rainless days during critical Kharif crop growth phases leading to temporary wilting.

stats.label: Watershed Soil Retention
stats.context: Fertile topsoil retained on terraced farmlands through community stone bunding and contour work.

carryOn.description: Widening monsoon dry spells and intense erratic downpours strip unbunded topsoil, depleting unmanaged shallow wells across the rain-shadow plateau.
keyPoints: Monsoon dry spells stretch beyond 40 days, stressing rainfed pulses and oilseeds
Over 3,400 villages face chronic seasonal water tanker dependency
Severe soil organic matter oxidation compromises agricultural land carrying capacity

protect.description: Ridge-to-valley watershed treatment, farm ponds, continuous contour trenches, and organic soil enrichment build enduring hydrological resilience.
keyPoints: Community contour stone bunding captures 85% of surface monsoon runoff
Decentralized recharge shafts restore year-round water tables in open wells
Diversified agroforestry and millet cultivation eliminate emergency water tanker needs
